entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Santa Teresa del Bambin Gesù in Panfilo is a church in the Pinciano quarter of Rome, at the junction of via Giovanni Paisiello and via Gaspare Spontini. It is dedicated to Teresa of Lisieux and since its inception has been run by the Discalced Carmelites, whose monastery next door was completed in 1929.
